Flèches, ZQSD ou souris : bouger · le va: Arrows, ZQSD or mouse: move · the ship fires on its own · space or right click: bomb (one per wave) · P or Escape: pause. Only the cockpit (the white dot) can be hit. Meteors, drones, and a flagship every 5 waves. Bonus: stronger weapon, shield, life.
Jeu de tir spatial vertical : ton vaisse: A vertical space shooter: your ship fires on its own, move it with the keyboard or mouse to destroy meteors that split, drones in waves and a flagship every 5 waves. Only the cockpit can be hit; bombs, shield, magnet, lives and a weapon up to level 5, a multiplier up to ×8, and score and wave records. Big pixel-art text, music and sounds made live, gamepad, full screen.
